BreathQuest: Gamified Breathwork Meditation for a Healthier You

Transform your breathwork routine into an engaging and interactive experience with BreathQuest. Our innovative app analyzes your microphone and camera data to detect your breathing patterns, turning your inhales and exhales into game controls. As you breathe, guide an object down a path, collect tokens by inhaling to move up and exhaling to move down. 

Start with a free trial, then unlock full access to all features with a subscription.

Full Version Features (Subscription Required):
- Interactive Gameplay: Control an object's movement using your breath. Inhale to move up, exhale to move down.
- Health-Promoting Patterns: Collect tokens spaced to encourage specific breathing patterns, designed to enhance your physical and mental well-being.
- Real-Time Feedback: Get instant feedback on your breathing with our precise microphone and camera analysis.
- Progress Tracking: Monitor your breathing habits, scores, and improvements over time.
- Relaxing Environment: Enjoy a visually appealing and calming game setting while practicing effective breathwork techniques.

How It Works:
BreathQuest analyzes your microphone and camera data to detect your breathing patterns, turning your inhales and exhales into game controls. Guide an object down a path, collecting tokens by inhaling to move up and exhaling to move down.

Experience the power of gamified breathwork with BreathQuest. Download now to discover how BreathQuest can transform your breathing practice!

show_hn.title: Show HN: An interactive breathing meditation game using microphone and camera

quotes.text:
Hey HN! I wanted to share a project that combines two of my passions: programming and breathwork.

For those unfamiliar with breathwork, it's a powerful technique that involves controlling your breathing patterns to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and improve overall well-being. It's been an absolute game-changer for my meditation practice and general levels of focus.

However, when I introduced breathwork to friends, many struggled to stay focused or weren't sure if they were doing it correctly. I realized there might be a need for a tool that could guide people through breathwork while providing real-time feedback.

I decided to take matters into my own hands and built BreathQuest- an iOS app that gamifies breathwork using computer vision and audio processing (all done locally using AVKit). The app detects when you're inhaling, exhaling, or holding your breath using your device's microphone and camera. As an object moves across the screen, you collect tokens by inhaling to move the ball upward and exhaling to move it downward. The tokens are strategically placed to guide you through specific breathing patterns to improve physical and mental health.

Some of the challenges I faced:

1. Accurately detecting breathing patterns using audio and video data in real-time

2. Balancing engaging gameplay with the relaxing nature of breathwork

3. Providing meaningful biofeedback to help users track their progress and improve their practice
